sentences.text: State vs Kanhaiya Lal (2025:Rj-Jd:43645) on 3 October, 2025

Author: Dinesh Mehta
Bench: Dinesh Mehta
[2025:Rj-Jd:43645] High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan At Jodhpur S.B.
Criminal Appeal No. 615/1996 State of Rajasthan
----Appellant Versus Kanhaiya Lal S/o Shri Ladu Ram Jat, R/o Moonpura, Tehsil Mandalgarh,
District Bhilwara.
----Respondent For Appellant(s) : Mr. Shravan Singh Rathore, Pp For Respondent(s) : Mr.
Paramveer Singh Justice Dinesh Mehta Order 03/10/2025
1.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan At Jodhpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The instant appeal has been filed under Section 378(iii) and
(i) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 by the State of Rajasthan against the judgment and order
dated 14.06.1996 passed by the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Mandalgarh, District
Bhilwara (hereinafter referred to as the 'trial Court') in Criminal Case No.56/87, whereby the trial
Court had acquitted the accused-respondent for the charge of offence under section 7/16 of the
Prevention of Food Adulteration (Pfa) Act of 1954 (hereinafter referred to as the 'Act of 1954').
2. The State of Rajasthan had filed a complaint against the accused-respondent under the provisions
of the Act of 1954 inter alia alleging that the milk which the accused-respondent was selling, was
adulterated/contaminated.

entities.text: Prevention of Food Adulteration (Pfa) Act of 1954
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3. Mr. Paramveer Singh, learned counsel for the respondent- accused at the outset informed that the
respondent-accused has since passed away and the appeal has therefore, been abated.
4.  Mr. Shravan Singh Rathore, learned Public Prosecutor was directed to ensure the factum of death of accused-respondent.
In turn, he has produced the death certificate of accused-respondent.
The same is taken on record.
5. In view of above, the appeal in hand is dismissed as abated.
